title: Reach-Avoid Model Predictive Control with Guaranteed Recursive Feasibility via Input Constrained Backstepping
summary: This letter proposes a novel sampled-data model predictive control framework for continuous control-affine nonlinear systems that provides rigorous reach-avoid and recursive feasibility guarantees under physical constraints. By propagating both input and output constraints through backstepping process, we present a constructive approach to synthesize a reach-avoid invariant set that complies with control input limits.
